Baseline false fragmentation retained. Analytic tangency and above-tolerance crossing/clearance regressions at absolute 1e-6 and 1e-9. All 121 saved intersection/cutting command records replayed at absolute 1e-8, relative 1e-12; same-request portable/native values retained separately. No fresh Rhino observation, general topology/completeness or speed claim.
